labels.text: section 4974(e): 10 percent substituted for 25 percent when the shortfall is corrected within the correction window

10 percent — added by the SECURE 2.0 Act of 2022 (Pub. L. 117-328, section 302), effective for taxable years beginning after December 29, 2022. 2023-01-01 is used as an approximate coverage-start boundary (not individually verified against a pinned note in this package's sources.law) — the RATE ITSELF (10 percent) is the pinned current text.
